prompt.text:
Implement a standard-library-only 3D mask comparison API in `solution.rs`.

Expose:
- `pub struct Mask3 { ... }`
- `pub enum MaskError { ShapeOverflow, LengthMismatch }`
- `pub struct Overlap { pub both_set: usize, pub both_clear: usize, pub left_only: usize, pub right_only: usize }`
- `pub struct Scores { pub dice: f64, pub jaccard: f64 }`
- `pub fn compare_masks(left: &Mask3, right: &Mask3) -> Result<Overlap, MaskError>`

`Mask3::new(width, height, depth, cells)` must reject an overflowing dimension product and any cell count unequal to `width * height * depth`. `compare_masks` must return `LengthMismatch` when dimensions differ, must not mutate either mask, and must count corresponding cells in traversal order. `Overlap::scores()` computes Dice and Jaccard similarity using set cells. When neither mask has a set cell, both scores are defined as `1.0`. Zero-sized masks are valid when their cell vector is empty.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
